EVAL-CT-M1-S1.title: Define Trial Phase Quality Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M1-S1.description: Define structured schema for representing clinical trial phase (I–IV) and corresponding quality score, including normalization rules and allowed values.

EVAL-CT-M1-S2.title: Implement Trial Phase Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M1-S2.description: Implement mapping from clinical trial phase (Phase I–IV) to a normalized quality score reflecting maturity and validation strength, including handling of missing or non-standard phase values.

EVAL-CT-M1-S3.title: Expose Trial Phase Quality via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M1-S3.description: Integrate trial phase quality score into clinical trial results returned by evaluate_care_facade, ensuring consistent response structure for downstream UI and explainability.

EVAL-CT-M1-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Trial Phase Quality
EVAL-CT-M1-S4.description: Create unit tests for phase-to-score mapping and edge cases (missing, malformed phases) and integration tests validating presence of quality score in end-to-end clinical trial responses.

EVAL-CT-M1-S5.title: Extract and Normalize Trial Phase from ClinicalTrials.gov Data
EVAL-CT-M1-S5.description: Parse trial phase values from ClinicalTrials.gov API responses, normalize variants (e.g., 'Phase 1/Phase 2', 'Early Phase 1') into standard categories, and handle missing or multi-phase trials prior to scoring.
